what_it_does: Returns the session tenant WhatsApp menu (from document upload / AI bifurcation + manual edits). Tenant comes from username+session_id — do not send tenant_id.
notes: Response: menu.buttons[] with id,title,description,section,enabled,flow,intent,sort_order. Also live_menu for published copy.

what_it_does: Adds one menu option. Id auto-slugged from title if omitted. Default publish=true (company admin → pending_approval; super_admin publishes live).
notes: Optional: id, flow, intent, sort_order, icon, requires_feature, out_of_hours_only, publish:false to draft-only.

what_it_does: Updates an existing option by id (title/description/section/enabled/flow/intent/…).
notes: id required. Omitted fields keep previous values where applicable.

what_it_does: Deletes a menu option. Uses tombstone so vertical defaults cannot bring it back.
